text: {"answer": "The Late Bronze Age collapse was caused by a combination of factors including invasions by the Sea Peoples, internal strife, economic disruption, and environmental changes. These factors led to the decline of major civilizations such as the Hittite Empire and Mycenaean Greece, primarily during the late 13th to early 12th century BC."}
